title: Normality of a local ring, of its henselization and of its strict henselization are equivalent
author: The Stacks Project Authors
work: Stacks Project, chapter more-algebra.tex (More on Algebra)
source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file more-algebra.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261012
difficulty_reason: The lemma shows that a local ring is a normal domain exactly when its henselization and exactly when its strict henselization is. The proof records first that for a local ring normality is the same as being a normal domain. Since the henselization maps are faithfully flat, one direction descends normality along them by the standard descent result. For the converse, the henselization and strict henselization are filtered colimits of etale, hence smooth, algebras over the ring, so normality ascends from the ring using the corresponding ascent results for smooth maps and for filtered colimits.
